The '''2023–24 Hershey Bears season''' was the franchise's [[List of Hershey Bears seasons|86th season]] in the [[American Hockey League]] (AHL), starting on October 14, 2023, and ending during the [[2024 Calder Cup playoffs|Calder Cup playoffs]]. They play their home games at [[Giant Center]].

On April 2, 2024, the Bears clinched a playoff berth for the third consecutive season following a 1–0 win over the [[Lehigh Valley Phantoms]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bears Clinch Atlantic Division in 1–0 Win Over Phantoms |url=https://www.hersheybears.com/news/bears-clinch-atlantic-division-in-1-0-win-over-phantoms/#:~:text=The%20Hershey%20Bears%20(48-12,Tuesday%20night%20at%20GIANT%20Center. |access-date=2024-05-28 |website=Hershey Bears}}</ref> In that same game, they clinched their division.

The Bears finished the season as Atlantic Division champions, their second in franchise history, and [[Macgregor Kilpatrick Trophy]] winners for the fourth time in franchise history, with a record-setting 111 points from 53 wins, 15 losses, and 5 shootout losses, their 53 wins also serving as a new AHL record under a 72 game season.<ref>{{ cite web | url=https://theahl.com/news/bears-fall-short-of-record-turn-attention-to-cup-repeat | title=Bears fall short of record, turn attention to Cup repeat | date = 21 April 2024}} </ref>

The Bears would win the [[Calder Cup]] in back to back years, beating the [[2023-24 Coachella Valley Firebirds season|Coachella Valley Firebirds]] in 6 games.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://theahl.com/news/new-faces-spark-bears-to-latest-calder-cup-championship |title=New faces spark Bears to latest Calder Cup championship |publisher=American Hockey League |date=June 25, 2024 |access-date=June 25, 2024}}</ref>
